item: विद्या ददाति विनयं विनयाद् याति पात्रताम्। पात्रत्वाद् धनमाप्नोति धनाद् धर्मं ततः सुखम्॥
mean: Knowledge makes you humble. Humility makes you worthy. Being worthy helps you earn wealth. Wealth lets you do good, and doing good brings happiness.
author: हितोपदेश

item: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः। न हि सुप्तस्य सिंहस्य प्रविशन्ति मुखे मृगाः॥
mean: Work gets things done, not just wishing. A deer will not walk into a sleeping lion's mouth by itself.
author: पञ्चतन्त्र

item: अयं निजः परो वेति गणना लघुचेतसाम्। उदारचरितानां तु वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्॥
mean: Only small-minded people think this is mine and that is yours. For big-hearted people, the whole world is one family.
author: महा उपनिषद

item: सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः। येनाक्रमन्त्यृषयो ह्याप्तकामा यत्र तत् सत्यस्य परमं निधानम्॥
mean: Only truth wins, not lies. Truth opens the path to God, and wise people follow it to the highest place.
author: मुण्डक उपनिषद

item: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
mean: Do your duty, but do not be attached to the result. Do not act just for reward, and do not avoid action.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: उत्तिष्ठत जाग्रत प्राप्य वरान्निबोधत। क्षुरस्य धारा निशिता दुरत्यया दुर्गं पथस्तत्कवयो वदन्ति॥
mean: Wake up, get up, and learn from great teachers. The path is as sharp as a razor's edge, so walk carefully.
author: कठोपनिषद

item: तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। असतो मा सद्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय॥
mean: Lead me from darkness to light, from lies to truth, and from death to eternal life.
author: बृहदारण्यक उपनिषद

item: यथा चित्तं तथा वाचो यथा वाचस्तथा क्रिया। चित्ते वाचि क्रियायां च साधूनामेकरूपता॥
mean: Your words follow your mind, and your actions follow your words. Good people keep mind, words, and actions the same.
author: सुभाषित

item: नास्ति विद्या समं चक्षुर्नास्ति सत्य समं तपः। नास्ति राग समं दुःखं नास्ति त्याग समं सुखम्॥
mean: Nothing is better than knowledge. Nothing is more powerful than truth. Nothing hurts like attachment, and nothing frees like letting go.
author: सुभाषित

item: शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनम्।
mean: Your body is the main tool for doing good deeds.
author: कालिदास

item: आलस्यं हि मनुष्याणां शरीरस्थो महान् रिपुः। नास्त्युद्यमसमो बन्धुः कृत्वा यं नावसीदति॥
mean: Laziness is your biggest enemy. Hard work is your best friend; with it, you never fail.
author: चाणक्य नीति

item: विद्या नाम नरस्य रूपमधिकं प्रच्छन्नगुप्तं धनम्। विद्या भोगकरी यशःसुखकरी विद्या गुरूणां गुरुः॥
mean: Knowledge is true beauty and hidden wealth. It brings joy, fame, and happiness. It is the teacher of all teachers.
author: भर्तृहरि

item: स्वदेशे पूज्यते राजा विद्वान् सर्वत्र पूज्यते। सर्वत्र पूज्यते विद्वान् न तु राजा स्वदेशेऽपि वा॥
mean: A king is honored only in his own land, but a wise person is respected everywhere.
author: चाणक्य नीति

item: सत्यं ब्रूयात् प्रियं ब्रूयात् न ब्रूयात् सत्यमप्रियम्। प्रियं च नानृतं ब्रूयादेष धर्मः सनातनः॥
mean: Speak truth in a kind way. Do not say harsh truth or pleasing lies. This is the eternal rule.
author: मनुस्मृति

item: यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत। अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
mean: Whenever goodness declines and evil rises, I appear to set things right.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: वासांसि जीर्णानि यथा विहाय नवानि गृह्णाति नरोऽपराणि। तथा शरीराणि विहाय जीर्णान्यन्यानि संयाति नवानि देही॥
mean: Just as we change old clothes for new, the soul leaves an old body for a new one.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः। वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते॥
mean: A wise person stays calm in pain, does not crave pleasure, and is free from fear, anger, and attachment.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: मन एव मनुष्याणां कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः। बन्धाय विषयासक्तं मुक्त्यै निर्विषयं स्मृतम्॥
mean: Your mind decides if you are bound or free. Attached to desires, you are bound; free from them, you are liberated.
author: अमृतबिन्दु उपनिषद

item: यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः। तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम॥
mean: Where Krishna and Arjuna are together, there is always victory, wealth, and good fortune.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता। योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः॥
mean: A steady mind is like a flame in a windless place—still and bright.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते।
mean: Control the mind by practice and letting go of attachments.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
mean: Nothing purifies like knowledge.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: श्रद्धावान् लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः।
mean: A devoted person with controlled senses gains knowledge.
author: भगवद्गीता

item: सुखं वाञ्छति सर्वोऽपि तच्च धर्मसमुद्भवम्।
mean: Everyone wants happiness, and true happiness comes from doing right.
author: सुभाषित

item: वाणी मधुरा यशः प्राप्नोति।
mean: Sweet words bring fame.
author: सुभाषित

item: परोपकाराय फलन्ति वृक्षाः परोपकाराय वहन्ति नद्यः। परोपकाराय दुहन्ति गावः परोपकारार्थमिदं शरीरम्॥
mean: Trees give fruit for others, rivers flow for others, cows give milk for others. Our body is also meant to serve others.
author: सुभाषित

item: न चौरहार्यं न च राजहार्यं न भ्रातृभाज्यं न च भारकारि। व्यये कृते वर्धत एव नित्यं विद्याधनं सर्वधनप्रधानम्॥
mean: Knowledge cannot be stolen, taken by force, divided, or felt heavy. The more you share it, the more it grows.
author: सुभाषित

item: यथा हि एकेन चक्रेण न रथस्य गतिर्भवेत्। एवं पुरुषकारेण विना दैवं न सिध्यति॥
mean: A chariot cannot move with one wheel. In the same way, fate cannot succeed without your own effort.
author: सुभाषित

item: अभिवादनशीलस्य नित्यं वृद्धोपसेविनः। चत्वारि तस्य वर्धन्ते आयुर्विद्या यशो बलम्॥
mean: Respecting elders and serving them brings long life, knowledge, fame, and strength.
author: सुभाषित

item: धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः। धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम्॥
mean: Courage, forgiveness, self-control, honesty, cleanliness, sense control, wisdom, knowledge, truth, and no anger—these ten are dharma.
author: मनुस्मृति

item: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः। सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत्॥
mean: May everyone be happy, healthy, and safe. May no one suffer.
author: संस्कृत प्रार्थना

item: ओम सह नाववतु सह नौ भुनक्तु सह वीर्यं करवावहै। तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै॥
mean: May we be protected together, enjoy together, work together, and never hate each other.
author: तैत्तिरीय उपनिषद

item: ज्ञान हेच श्रेष्ठ धन आहे, जे कोणीही चोरू शकत नाही।
mean: Knowledge is the best wealth because no one can steal it.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: जेथे जातो तेथे माझा विठोबा उभा।
mean: Wherever I go, my God is with me.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: शब्दांपेक्षा कृती बोलक्या असतात।
mean: Actions speak louder than words.
author: मराठी सुभाषित

item: मन करा रे प्रसन्न, सर्व सिद्धीचे कारण।
mean: Make your mind happy; it is the root of all success.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: विद्येविना मती गेली, मतीविना नीती गेली।
mean: Without learning, wisdom dies. Without wisdom, good values die.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: जो जे वांछिल, तो ते लाभे।
mean: Whatever you truly wish for, you will get.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: आपुली बुद्धि तारी, आपुली बुद्धि मारी।
mean: Your own wisdom can save you or destroy you.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: देखणे वाक्य मन वेधते।
mean: Beautiful words touch the heart.
author: पु. ल. देशपांडे

item: शिक्षण हे हत्यार आहे, त्याचा वापर करा।
mean: Education is a weapon; use it.
author: सावित्रीबाई फुले

item: जे का रंजले गांजले त्यासी म्हणे जो आपुले। तोचि साधू ओळखावा देव तेथेचि जाणावा॥
mean: A true saint treats the poor and suffering as family. God lives there.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: नामदेव म्हणे ज्ञानाचा सागरु।
mean: Namdev says knowledge is an ocean.
author: संत नामदेव महाराज

item: पसायदान हेचि देणे, जेणे विश्व सुखी पूर्ण होणे।
mean: This blessing fills the whole world with happiness.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: ज्ञानदेवा आता ज्ञानाची आवडी।
mean: O Dnyandev, now I love knowledge.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: भक्ति म्हणजे प्रेमाची पराकाष्ठा।
mean: Devotion is the highest form of love.
author: संत एकनाथ महाराज

item: कन्होबाच्या पायी माझे मन वेधले।
mean: My heart is captured at Lord Krishna's feet.
author: संत कान्होपात्रा

item: अभंगाची गोडी, विठ्ठलाची आवडी।
mean: Sweet songs and love for Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: सकळ ही माझे मनी, विठ्ठल ध्यानी।
mean: Vitthal is always in my mind.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञान हेच शस्त्र, भक्ती हेच बळ।
mean: Knowledge is the weapon, devotion is the strength.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: माझा मराठीचि बोलू कौतुके।
mean: I proudly speak my Marathi language.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: अमृताची फळे, ज्ञानाची सावली।
mean: Fruits of nectar, shade of knowledge.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: विठ्ठल विठ्ठल गजरी, आवडीची भरली उरी।
mean: Chanting Vitthal fills my heart with love.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: देह देवाचे मंदिर, आत्मा शिवाचा निवास।
mean: Body is God's temple, soul is Shiva's home.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: संतांचे महिमान, वर्णावे तितुके थोडे।
mean: The greatness of saints cannot be fully described.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: जय जय राम कृष्ण हरी।
mean: Victory to Ram, Krishna, and Hari.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भाग्याचे दार उघडले, विठ्ठल भेटले।
mean: When I met Vitthal, my fortune opened.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: प्रेमाचा झरा, भक्तीचा वारा।
mean: A stream of love, a wind of devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानियांचा राजा, भक्तांचा माहेर।
mean: King of the wise, home of devotees.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: सत्याची कास धरा, विठ्ठलाचा ध्यास धरा।
mean: Hold truth and meditate on Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: मनाचे श्लोक, मनाची आराधना।
mean: Verses of the mind, worship of the mind.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: दासबोध हे ज्ञानाचे भांडार।
mean: Dasbodh is a treasure of knowledge.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: करावे तर काही, होईल तर काही।
mean: Do something, and something will happen.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: जग हे विचित्र, कोणी नाही आपले।
mean: This world is strange; no one is truly ours.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: संसार हा दुःखाचा सागर।
mean: Worldly life is an ocean of sorrow.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भक्तीच्या जोरावर देव भेटतो।
mean: God is found through the strength of devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाचा दीप लावा, अज्ञानाचा अंधार जावा।
mean: Light the lamp of knowledge to remove the darkness of ignorance.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: वैराग्याची काठी, ज्ञानाची सोबत।
mean: Stick of detachment, company of knowledge.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: आत्मज्ञान हेच खरे ज्ञान।
mean: Knowing yourself is the real knowledge.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: प्रपंच करावा नेटका, विठ्ठल ध्यावा भेटका।
mean: Handle worldly duties well, but meet God through meditation.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: नामाचा महिमा अपार, उगवला संसार।
mean: The divine name is powerful and removes worldly troubles.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: काया ही पंढरी, आत्मा हा विठ्ठल।
mean: The body is Pandharpur, the soul is Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: जेथे शांती तेथे ईश्वर वसती।
mean: Where there is peace, God lives.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: मनाची शांती हेच खरे सुख।
mean: Peace of mind is real happiness.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: संतांची संगती, मोक्षाची पंक्ती।
mean: Company of saints leads to liberation.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानेश्वरी हे ज्ञानाचे देऊळ।
mean: Dnyaneshwari is a temple of knowledge.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भक्तीचा महिमा सांगता येत नाही।
mean: The glory of devotion cannot be fully told.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: विठ्ठलाचे नाम, संसाराचे आराम।
mean: The name of Vitthal gives peace in life.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: सद्गुरूची कृपा, भवसागराची नौका।
mean: The guru's grace is the boat across the ocean of life.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: मनाचा निग्रह, इंद्रियांचा संयम।
mean: Control the mind and restrain the senses.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: अहंकाराचा त्याग, भक्तीचा स्वीकार।
mean: Give up ego, accept devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानी तोचि दयाळू, भक्त तोचि कृपाळू।
mean: The wise are kind, devotees are merciful.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: संतांच्या पायी, स्वर्गाची ठायी।
mean: At saints' feet is heaven.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: भावाची भक्ती, प्रेमाची शक्ती।
mean: Devotion with feeling, strength of love.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: काळाचे चक्र, विठ्ठलाचे रक्षण।
mean: The wheel of time, protection of Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: अंतरीचा भाव, बाहेरील कळा।
mean: Inner feeling, outer glow.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: गुरूची महिमा, वर्णवेना शब्दांनी।
mean: The guru's greatness cannot be put into words.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: प्रेमाचा सागर, विठ्ठलाचा आधार।
mean: Ocean of love, support of Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाचा उजेड, अज्ञानाचा नाश।
mean: Light of knowledge destroys ignorance.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: नामस्मरणाची गोडी, संसाराची सोडवणूक।
mean: Chanting the divine name frees from worldly bondage.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: शांतीचा महिमा, संतोषाची सीमा।
mean: Glory of peace, limit of contentment.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भक्तीचा आनंद, विठ्ठलाचा छंद।
mean: Joy of devotion, love for Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: मनाची एकाग्रता, ध्यानाची समाधी।
mean: Focus the mind and sink into meditation.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: वैराग्याचे बळ, ज्ञानाचे फळ।
mean: Strength of detachment, fruit of knowledge.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: संतांचा आशीर्वाद, जीवनाचा प्रसाद।
mean: Blessings of saints are life's grace.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: भक्तीचा मार्ग, मोक्षाचा द्वार।
mean: Devotion is the door to freedom.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: आत्म्याचा शोध, परमेश्वराचा लाभ।
mean: Search for the soul leads to God.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: सत्याचा आग्रह, धर्माचा निग्रह।
mean: Stick to truth, commit to dharma.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: कर्माचे महत्व, भक्तीचे सामर्थ्य।
mean: Action is important, devotion is powerful.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: प्रेमाची भाषा, भक्तीची आशा।
mean: Language of love, hope of devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: अहंकाराचा नाश, ज्ञानाचा विकास।
mean: Destroy ego, grow knowledge.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: विठ्ठलाची आठवण, मनाची शांती।
mean: Remembering Vitthal brings peace of mind.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाची ज्योत, भक्तीची मोत।
mean: Flame of knowledge, pearl of devotion.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: संसाराचा त्याग, विठ्ठलाचा योग।
mean: Give up worldly life, unite with Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: सद्गुरूचे वचन, जीवनाचे भूषण।
mean: Guru's words are life's ornament.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: भक्तीची परंपरा, संतांची सोबत।
mean: Tradition of devotion, company of saints.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: नामाचा गजर, भक्तीचा सागर।
mean: Chanting the name, ocean of devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: मनाची शुद्धी, आत्म्याची बुद्धी।
mean: Pure mind, wise soul.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: प्रपंचाचा मार्ग, परमार्थाचा योग।
mean: Path of worldly life, union with God.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: विठ्ठलाची कृपा, भक्ताची दीक्षा।
mean: Vitthal's grace, devotee's initiation.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाचा वारसा, संतांचा ठेवा।
mean: Heritage of knowledge, treasure of saints.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भक्तीचा झरा, प्रेमाचा वारा।
mean: Spring of devotion, breeze of love.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: अंतरीचा दीप, बाहेरील उजेड।
mean: Inner lamp, outer light.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: कर्मयोगाची साधना, भक्तीयोगाची आराधना।
mean: Practice of action yoga, worship of devotion yoga.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: संतांची वाणी, अमृताची खाणी।
mean: Saints' words are a mine of nectar.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाची गंगा, भक्तीची यमुना।
mean: Ganga of knowledge, Yamuna of devotion.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: विठ्ठलाचे ध्यान, जीवनाचे प्राण।
mean: Meditation on Vitthal is life's breath.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: भक्तीचा अभ्यास, मोक्षाचा वास।
mean: Practice of devotion, home of liberation.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: मनाचा संयम, इंद्रियांचा नियम।
mean: Control the mind, regulate the senses.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: प्रेमाचा पाझर, भक्तीचा आधार।
mean: Flow of love, support of devotion.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाचा दीपक, अज्ञानाचा विलय।
mean: Lamp of knowledge, end of ignorance.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: सद्गुरूचा उपदेश, जीवनाचा संदेश।
mean: Guru's teaching is life's message.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: विठ्ठलाची भक्ती, संसाराची मुक्ती।
mean: Devotion to Vitthal frees from worldly bonds.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: आत्म्याचे ज्ञान, परमेश्वराचे ध्यान।
mean: Knowledge of soul, meditation on God.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: भक्तीचा महिमा, संतांची गरिमा।
mean: Glory of devotion, dignity of saints.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाचा सागर, भक्तीचा आगर।
mean: Ocean of knowledge, mine of devotion.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: कर्माची साधना, धर्माची आराधना।
mean: Practice of action, worship of dharma.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: विठ्ठलाचा नामजप, जीवनाचा तप।
mean: Chanting Vitthal's name is life's penance.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: संतांचा सहवास, देवाचा निवास।
mean: Company of saints is God's home.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: प्रेमाची भक्ती, विठ्ठलाची शक्ती।
mean: Devotion of love, power of Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: ज्ञानाची कास, भक्तीची वास।
mean: Hold of knowledge, fragrance of devotion.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: मनाची एकता, ध्यानाची समता।
mean: Unity of mind, balance in meditation.
author: समर्थ रामदास स्वामी

item: भक्तीचा उत्सव, विठ्ठलाचा महोत्सव।
mean: Festival of devotion, celebration of Vitthal.
author: संत तुकाराम महाराज

item: आत्म्याचा विकास, ज्ञानाचा प्रकाश।
mean: Growth of soul, light of knowledge.
author: संत ज्ञानेश्वर महाराज

item: The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
mean: Love your work. If you haven't found what you love, keep searching. Don't settle.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
mean: Life happens while you are busy making other plans.
author: John Lennon

item: The purpose of our lives is to be happy.
mean: Our main goal is to be happy.
author: Dalai Lama

item: Get busy living or get busy dying.
mean: Either live fully or waste away.
author: Stephen King

item: You only live once, but if you do it right, once is enough.
mean: You live once; if you live well, once is enough.
author: Mae West

item: Many of life's failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up.
mean: Many people quit just before success.
author: Thomas A. Edison

item: The unexamined life is not worth living.
mean: A life without self-reflection is not worth living.
author: Socrates

item: Turn your wounds into wisdom.
mean: Turn your pain into lessons.
author: Oprah Winfrey

item: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
mean: Stop talking and start doing.
author: Walt Disney

item: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
mean: Success isn't forever, failure isn't the end; keep going.
author: Winston Churchill

item: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
mean: Success comes to those focused on work, not chasing it.
author: Henry David Thoreau

item: Opportunities don't happen. You create them.
mean: You create your own opportunities.
author: Chris Grosser

item: Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
mean: Let go of good to reach great.
author: John D. Rockefeller

item: I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.
mean: The more I work, the luckier I get.
author: Thomas Jefferson

item: Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
mean: Keep enthusiasm even after failing.
author: Winston Churchill

item: Try not to become a man of success. Rather become a man of value.
mean: Be useful, not just successful.
author: Albert Einstein

item: The secret of success is to do the common thing uncommonly well.
mean: Do ordinary things very well.
author: John D. Rockefeller Jr.

item: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
mean: The best time to start was earlier; the next best is now.
author: Chinese Proverb

item: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
mean: Don't live someone else's life.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
mean: Believing is half the battle.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

item: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
mean: What you want is on the other side of fear.
author: George Addair

item: It always seems impossible until it's done.
mean: It feels impossible until done.
author: Nelson Mandela

item: Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying 'I will try again tomorrow.'
mean: Courage is quietly trying again tomorrow.
author: Mary Anne Radmacher

item: The harder the conflict, the more glorious the triumph.
mean: Bigger fights bring bigger wins.
author: Thomas Paine

item: Creativity is intelligence having fun.
mean: Creativity is intelligence playing.
author: Albert Einstein

item: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
mean: Innovation separates leaders from followers.
author: Steve Jobs

item: The true sign of intelligence is not knowledge but imagination.
mean: Imagination matters more than knowledge.
author: Albert Einstein

item: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
mean: The more you use creativity, the more you have.
author: Maya Angelou

item: Every artist was first an amateur.
mean: Every expert was once a beginner.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

item: A leader is one who knows the way, goes the way, and shows the way.
mean: A leader shows the way by walking it.
author: John C. Maxwell

item: Leadership is the capacity to translate vision into reality.
mean: Leaders turn vision into reality.
author: Warren Bennis

item: Don't find fault, find a remedy.
mean: Find solutions, not faults.
author: Henry Ford

item: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
mean: Live each day fully and never stop learning.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

item: Anyone who stops learning is old, whether at twenty or eighty. Anyone who keeps learning stays young.
mean: Keep learning to stay young.
author: Henry Ford

item: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
mean: Education changes the world.
author: Nelson Mandela

item: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
mean: I learn best by doing.
author: Benjamin Franklin

item: The beautiful thing about learning is that nobody can take it away from you.
mean: No one can take away what you learn.
author: B.B. King

item: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
mean: Be yourself; everyone else is taken.
author: Oscar Wilde

item: Two things are infinite: the universe and human stupidity; and I'm not sure about the universe.
mean: The universe and human foolishness have no limit.
author: Albert Einstein

item: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
mean: Change yourself to change the world.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

item: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
mean: Life goes on.
author: Robert Frost

item: Don't cry because it's over, smile because it happened.
mean: Smile because it happened.
author: Dr. Seuss

item: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
mean: Most people just exist; few truly live.
author: Oscar Wilde

item: Always forgive your enemies; nothing annoys them so much.
mean: Forgive enemies; it annoys them.
author: Oscar Wilde

item: We accept the love we think we deserve.
mean: We accept the love we think we deserve.
author: Stephen Chbosky

item: Without music, life would be a mistake.
mean: Life without music is a mistake.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

item: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
mean: Hard times make you stronger.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

item: It is never too late to be what you might have been.
mean: You can still become what you wanted.
author: George Eliot

item: Everything you can imagine is real.
mean: Imagination makes things real.
author: Pablo Picasso

item: When one door of happiness closes, another opens; but often we look so long at the closed door that we do not see the one which has been opened for us.
mean: Don't miss new open doors.
author: Helen Keller

item: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
mean: Use what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

item: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
mean: Happiness comes from your actions.
author: Dalai Lama

item: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
mean: Dreamers shape the future.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

item: The best revenge is massive success.
mean: Success is the best revenge.
author: Frank Sinatra

item: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
mean: If you don't try, you always fail.
author: Wayne Gretzky

item: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
mean: Your belief shapes your outcome.
author: Henry Ford

item: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
mean: You decide who you become.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

item: Everything has beauty, but not everyone can see.
mean: Beauty is everywhere, but not everyone sees it.
author: Confucius

item: Believe in yourself and all that you are. Know that there is something inside you that is greater than any obstacle.
mean: Trust your inner strength.
author: Christian D. Larson

item: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
mean: Doubts today limit tomorrow.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

item: Do one thing every day that scares you.
mean: Do something scary daily.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

item: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
mean: Your inner strength matters most.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

item: The best way out is always through.
mean: Go through the problem.
author: Robert Frost

item: Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
mean: Chasing perfection leads to excellence.
author: Vince Lombardi

item: If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
mean: Help others to rise.
author: Booker T. Washington

item: You can never cross the ocean until you have the courage to lose sight of the shore.
mean: Take risks to achieve big things.
author: Christopher Columbus

item: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
mean: You must act on knowledge.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

item: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
mean: Stay curious and bold.
author: Steve Jobs

item: The only way to discover the limits of the possible is to go beyond them into the impossible.
mean: Push beyond what seems possible.
author: Arthur C. Clarke

item: Life is 10% what happens to me and 90% of how I react to it.
mean: Life is how you react.
author: Charles Swindoll

item: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
mean: Add value, not just success.
author: Albert Einstein

item: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
mean: You become what you think.
author: Buddha

item: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
mean: Find peace inside.
author: Buddha

item: Holding on to anger is like grasping a hot coal with the intent of throwing it at someone else; you are the one who gets burned.
mean: Anger burns you.
author: Buddha

item: Thousands of candles can be lighted from a single candle, and the life of the candle will not be shortened. Happiness never decreases by being shared.
mean: Happiness grows when shared.
author: Buddha

item: You will not be punished for your anger, you will be punished by your anger.
mean: Anger itself punishes you.
author: Buddha

item: The only real failure in life is not to be true to the best one knows.
mean: Not living your truth is failure.
author: Buddha

item: In the end, only three things matter: how much you loved, how gently you lived, and how gracefully you let go of things not meant for you.
mean: Love, live gently, let go gracefully.
author: Buddha

item: The root of suffering is attachment.
mean: Attachment causes suffering.
author: Buddha

item: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
mean: Live in the present.
author: Buddha

item: Health is the greatest gift, contentment the greatest wealth, faithfulness the best relationship.
mean: Health, contentment, faithfulness are true wealth.
author: Buddha

item: There is no path to happiness: happiness is the path.
mean: Happiness is the journey.
author: Buddha

item: A jug fills drop by drop.
mean: Small steps fill big goals.
author: Buddha

item: Better than a thousand hollow words, is one word that brings peace.
mean: One peaceful word beats many empty ones.
author: Buddha

item: An idea that is developed and put into action is more important than an idea that exists only as an idea.
mean: Action matters more than ideas.
author: Buddha

item: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work.
mean: Find work you love.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.
mean: Trust your inner voice.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Have the courage to follow your heart and intuition. They somehow already know what you truly want to become.
mean: Follow your heart.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Sometimes life hits you in the head with a brick. Don't lose faith.
mean: Don't lose faith in hard times.
author: Steve Jobs

item: The people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world are the ones who do.
mean: Crazy dreamers change the world.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Being the richest man in the cemetery doesn't matter to me. Going to bed at night saying we've done something wonderful... that's what matters to me.
mean: Making a difference matters more than money.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Creativity is just connecting things.
mean: Creativity is connecting ideas.
author: Steve Jobs

item: Details matter, it's worth waiting to get it right.
mean: Details matter; wait to get them right.
author: Steve Jobs

item: The greatest thing about being an entrepreneur is that no one tells you what to do. The worst thing about being an entrepreneur is that no one tells you what to do.
mean: Freedom and responsibility both come with entrepreneurship.
author: Anonymous

item: An entrepreneur is someone who jumps off a cliff and builds a plane on the way down.
mean: Entrepreneurs take leaps and learn as they fall.
author: Reid Hoffman

item: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
mean: Create your own future.
author: Peter Drucker

item: Risk more than others think is safe. Dream more than others think is practical.
mean: Take bigger risks, dream bigger.
author: Howard Schultz

item: Chase the vision, not the money; the money will end up following you.
mean: Follow vision, money follows.
author: Tony Hsieh

item: Done is better than perfect.
mean: Done beats perfect.
author: Sheryl Sandberg

item: Move fast and break things. Unless you are breaking stuff, you are not moving fast enough.
mean: Move fast and break things.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

item: The biggest risk is not taking any risk.
mean: Not taking risks is the biggest risk.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

item: In a world that's changing really quickly, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risks.
mean: In a fast-changing world, not risking fails.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

item: People don't care about what you say, they care about what you build.
mean: People care about what you build.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

item: Building a mission and building a business go hand in hand.
mean: Mission and business go together.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

item: Books are a uniquely portable magic.
mean: Books are magic you can carry.
author: Stephen King

item: If you don't have time to read, you don't have the time (or the tools) to write. Simple as that.
mean: If you don't read, you can't write well.
author: Stephen King

item: Good books don't give up all their secrets at once.
mean: Great books reveal slowly.
author: Stephen King

item: The scariest moment is always just before you start.
mean: Starting is the scariest part.
author: Stephen King

item: Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
mean: Pros work; amateurs wait for inspiration.
author: Stephen King

item: Talent is cheaper than table salt. What separates the talented individual from the successful one is a lot of hard work.
mean: Hard work beats talent.
author: Stephen King

item: We never know which lives we influence, or when, or why.
mean: You never know who you impact.
author: Stephen King

item: Fiction is the truth inside the lie.
mean: Fiction hides truth inside story.
author: Stephen King

item: There's no harm in hoping for the best as long as you're prepared for the worst.
mean: Hope for best, prepare for worst.
author: Stephen King

item: In the end, we all become stories.
mean: We all become stories.
author: Margaret Atwood

item: A word after a word after a word is power.
mean: Words hold power.
author: Margaret Atwood

item: If you want to know what a man's like, take a good look at how he treats his inferiors, not his equals.
mean: How they treat inferiors shows character.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
mean: Don't dream and forget to live.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: We are only as strong as we are united, as weak as we are divided.
mean: Unity is strength.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
mean: Choices define you.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: Words are, in my not-so-humble opinion, our most inexhaustible source of magic.
mean: Words are endless magic.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: It matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be.
mean: What you become matters, not birth.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: Do not pity the dead, Harry. Pity the living, and, above all, those who live without love.
mean: Pity those who live without love.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
mean: Death is next adventure.
author: J.K. Rowling

item: The world is full of obvious things which nobody by any chance ever observes.
mean: People miss obvious things.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: There is nothing more deceptive than an obvious fact.
mean: Obvious facts can mislead.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
mean: Remove impossible, remaining is truth.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: It is a capital mistake to theorize before one has data.
mean: Don't theorize without data.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: You see, but you do not observe.
mean: Looking isn't observing.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: Mediocrity knows nothing higher than itself; but talent instantly recognizes genius.
mean: Talent recognizes genius.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: Education never ends, Watson. It is a series of lessons, with the greatest for the last.
mean: Learning is lifelong.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: The game is afoot.
mean: Action begins.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: I never guess. It is a shocking habit—destructive to the logical faculty.
mean: Guessing harms logic.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: Data! Data! Data! I can't make bricks without clay.
mean: Need data to build understanding.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: Work is the best antidote to sorrow.
mean: Work cures sorrow.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: Life is infinitely stranger than anything which the mind of man could invent.
mean: Truth is stranger than fiction.
author: Sherlock Holmes

item: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched – they must be felt with the heart.
mean: Best things are felt by heart.
author: Helen Keller

item: Keep your face always toward the sunshine – and shadows will fall behind you.
mean: Stay positive, shadows fall behind.
author: Walt Whitman

item: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
mean: Rising after falling is glory.
author: Nelson Mandela

item: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
mean: Make everyone happier.
author: Mother Teresa

item: When you reach the end of your rope, tie a knot in it and hang on.
mean: Hang on when tough.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

item: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else.
mean: Everyone is unique.
author: Margaret Mead

item: Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant.
mean: Focus on seeds planted.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

item: The greatest wealth is to live content with little.
mean: Being content with little is true wealth.
author: Plato

item: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
mean: Fear itself is the enemy.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

item: It is not the mountain we conquer but ourselves.
mean: Conquer yourself.
author: Edmund Hillary

item: The purpose of art is washing the dust of daily life off our souls.
mean: Art cleans the soul.
author: Pablo Picasso

item: Action is the foundational key to all success.
mean: Action is key to success.
author: Pablo Picasso

item: Any fool can write code that a computer can understand. Good programmers write code that humans can understand.
mean: Write code for humans, not computers.
author: Martin Fowler

item: The best error message is the one that never shows up.
mean: Best error is no error.
author: Thomas Fuchs

item: Debugging is twice as hard as writing the code in the first place.
mean: Fixing bugs is harder than writing code.
author: Brian Kernighan

item: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
mean: Show code, not talk.
author: Linus Torvalds

item: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
mean: Code should be readable by people.
author: Harold Abelson

item: Deleted code is debugged code.
mean: Removing code removes bugs.
author: Jeff Sickel

item: Technology is best when it brings people together.
mean: Tech connects people.
author: Matt Mullenweg

item: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
mean: Advanced tech looks like magic.
author: Arthur C. Clarke

item: The science of today is the technology of tomorrow.
mean: Today's science becomes tomorrow's tech.
author: Edward Teller

item: Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master.
mean: Tech should serve, not control.
author: Christian Lous Lange

item: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
mean: Create future.
author: Peter Drucker

item: What is now proved was once only imagined.
mean: Imagination precedes invention.
author: William Blake

item: Small opportunities are often the beginning of great enterprises.
mean: Big things start small.
author: Demosthenes
